description: List the endurance races this site publishes results explorers for — L'Étape du Tour, the Marathon and Semi de Paris, the Triathlon de l'Alpe d'Huez, La Marmotte and their archive editions — with each one's year, sport, distance, finisher count and URL. Use this when the user asks what race data this site has, asks about results or statistics for one of these events, or wants to know how many people finished a particular edition. Returns aggregate figures per race only.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

year.description: Filter to a single edition year.

name: list_race_explorers
